fusions.name: Mountain's Weight
fusions.desc: Brings your full weight down, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 25%).

fusions.name: Paw Swat
fusions.desc: A raking weapon strike that deals 13 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Settled Stance
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 24 damage for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Hunker Down
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
